about.description: iHELP is a charitable foundation that supports families, children, and vulnerable groups in Ukraine’s hardest-hit regions. We deliver humanitarian aid, strengthen communities, and contribute to the country’s recovery. Together, we can change lives for the better.
about.title: Core Programmes
about.firstProjectDescription: We deliver food, medicine, hygiene kits, and warm clothing to families in urgent need.
about.secondProjectDescription: Transportation for people with disabilities and residents of frontline communities in Kherson and Mykolaiv regions with limited mobility to undergo vital procedures.
about.thirdProjectDescription: We provide emotional and educational support to children affected by war - including psychological care, learning materials, and creative programmes.

valentina.testimony: “I am extremely grateful for this service! The driver, Oleh, is amazingly attentive — he points everything out and drops you off right at the doorstep. Everything is organized so well. May God bless you with all the best; you are doing a truly wonderful and noble cause by helping people solve vital matters!”
valentina.author: Valentyna
valentina.testimonyAboutAuthor: Valentyna lives in a frontline village in southern Ukraine where public transport is severely limited. Thanks to the Social Taxi project, she can safely travel to the hospital for life-saving procedures and access vital social and administrative services.

liudmila.testimony: “Thank you so much! This kind of assistance is a true lifeline for us. It is so difficult for us to get to the hospital on our own, but with you, everything was so easy and quick. I can hardly believe we were able to travel that far. Thank you very much for your care!”
liudmila.author: Liudmyla
liudmila.testimonyAboutAuthor: Liudmyla lives in a frontline village in southern Ukraine with heavily damaged infrastructure. Thanks to the Social Taxi project, she can safely reach the hospital to undergo life-saving medical procedures.

andrii.testimony: “Deepest gratitude to you for providing such a service for people with disabilities, helping them reach hospitals and access essential services. Otherwise, they simply cannot get to the city by public transport, and hiring a private car costs a fortune — around 5,000 UAH.”
andrii.author: Andrii
andrii.testimonyAboutAuthor: Lives in a frontline village with destroyed infrastructure and no public transport links, where private rides cost around 10,000 UAH. For people with disabilities, this makes access to hospitals nearly impossible. Thanks to the Social Taxi project, he completed 5 trips to undergo medical examinations and reconfirm his disability status to secure state guarantees.

oleksandr.testimony: “It’s great that such a service exists to help people reach hospitals for examinations. Everything was comfortable and went smoothly.”
oleksandr.author: Oleksandr
oleksandr.testimonyAboutAuthor: Lives in the Kherson region, where transport connections are extremely difficult due to destroyed infrastructure and continuous shelling. Thanks to the Social Taxi project, he was able to reach the hospital for a medical examination to obtain disability status.

nadia.testimony: “This service is a huge help because my son has mobility issues. The thought of having to travel together to a government office to complete paperwork was completely overwhelming. It is extremely hard for people with disabilities to reach hospitals and administrative services on their own.”
nadia.author: Nadiia
nadia.authorData: Social Taxi user with her son, Kherson Region
nadia.testimonyAboutAuthor: They live in the Kherson region, where transport connections are extremely difficult due to destroyed infrastructure and systematic shelling. Thanks to the Social Taxi project, together with her son, they were able to obtain the necessary documents by traveling from their home to a government institution and returning back home.

impactBlock.testimony: “With a driver like this, we can overcome any challenge. Before, even getting to a doctor felt impossible. Now I know I am not forgotten.”
impactBlock.author: Olha, 72
impactBlock.testimonyAboutAuthor: Olha lives in a frontline village where public transport has long disappeared. Through the Social Taxi initiative, she can safely reach medical care, humanitarian support points, and reconnect with her community.
